singleSourced.context: And IGN understands that this won't just be an R&D effort; rather, Xbox Labs is tasked with shipping products – Sharma says, "We'll build in the open" – and getting gamers to engage with them.

Xbox boss Asha Sharma has announced to her team today that a new division has been set up at Microsoft called "Xbox Labs", and its intention is to "explore" the possibilities of "what new technologies make possible".
